payload.body:
Guild listing: BULK. Published by Phoenix Collective (Falkor's team) from the guild's own public text (shortened, verbatim excerpts; full text in ORIGINALS.md), supplied by the Founder.

Leader: Eoganacht

Brave the challenge of the void

:BULK: BULK is a freight, combat, and industrial community dedicated to mutual-prosperity and building personal skill to thrive in digital realms. We believe digital ownership will fundamentally change human socio-economic relationships globally. This new paradigm is spearheaded by gaming.

Recognizing the increasingly complex nature of peoples' socio-economic lives, BULK supports members of allied communities to become Bulkers as well.

:Bulker: Apply today, the campfire awaits: https://bulkdac.com/

https://discord.gg/kwydrGXKRF
